title: Ticking all the boxes
body: Good design, many features with simplicity to setup all you need to track your habit goals. Even if you are missing something, the feature depth is rich enough for you to find the workarounds to achieve what you are after. Responsive and competent customer service as well. Great job guys, keep it up!
author: berkopath

title: At last great UX! Thank you for that!
body: I was looking for you for so long!
author: nazmariam

title: Best habit app!
body: I’ve tried too many habit tracking apps to mention; but, this one is by far the best I’ve used. It has great functionality and flexibility.
author: Donni14

title: Simple, Effective, and Beautifully Designed
body: Habitify stands out as one of the best habit trackers I’ve ever used. The design is clean, intuitive, and distraction-free, making daily use effortless. Its great usability allows you to create and track habits without any hassle.

title: Quase perfeita
body: A app tem tudo para ser a melhor do género só falta uma funcionalidade super simples e crucial. A possibilidade de fazer snooze nos lembretes. Posso não conseguir fazer um objetivo agora e querer ser lembrado daqui a 15 mins. Algumas apps do género têm essa opção com 3D Touch. Espero que adicionem nesta também pra ficar perfeita

author: Lothell

title: Bugs
body: You clearly haven't tested this much. The top bar on the journal only shows 6 days of the week (doesn't show the current day), which means that when I select any of the other days there doesn't seem to be a way to get back to the current day. Also, I have no way to tell if those days are from this week or last week, since there's no indication of date whatsoever. And none of my habits appear on the other days. No idea why.

title: Great app, awesome design.
